description: South Carolina individual income tax. 2026 rates and SC income adjusted deduction (SCIAD) from Act 110 of 2026 (H.4216); starting point is federal AGI. Retirement, age-65, Social Security and capital gain provisions are from existing SC Code sections not amended by Act 110.
verification: Rates and SCIAD verified against the ratified Act 110 text on 2026-11-04. Section 12-6-1170 amounts are unchanged law; confirm against the 2026 SC1040 instructions when published.
